command.mac:
cd /tmp
git clone --filter=blob:none https://github.com/shivinate7/degen.git degen-428
cd /tmp/degen-428
git checkout --detach 1dd63cc8892d02b228aa0ab3d9d745d2f2962cf2
make native-build && echo "native-check: pass 1dd63cc8892d02b228aa0ab3d9d745d2f2962cf2 $(date +%F)"

context:
